question:
In April 2025, Union Minister of Commerce & Industry, Shri Piyush Goyal announced that Second Fund of Funds for Startups worth Rs.

_________ crore to boost deep-tech and early-stage innovation has been approved.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10,000 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• In **April 2025**, the Union Minister of Commerce & Industry, **Shri Piyush Goyal**, announced the approval of the **Second Fund of Funds for Startups** (FFS) worth **10,000 crore**.

• The fund aims to **boost deep-tech and early-stage innovation** in India, thereby fostering technological advancements and entrepreneurial growth.

• The initiative is part of the government’s larger strategy to make India a global hub for **startups and innovation**.

• The **Second Fund of Funds** builds on the success of the **first FFS**, which was launched in **2016** under the Startup India initiative and had a corpus of **10,000 crore**.

• The fund will be managed by the **Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)**, in collaboration with other institutional investors, to support startups across various sect
